column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to impart and promote the study of Hinduism and
all its scriptures and the teaching of Sri Ramakrishna
Paramahamsa,  Sri  Sarada  Devi  and  Swami
Vivekananda within the Hindu community;
to  promote  the  study  of  comparative  theology  in
its  widest  form  and  assist  in  bringing  about  the
harmony of all religions;
to  promote,  encourage  and  assist  the  religious,
educational,  social  and  cultural  advancement  of
Hindu women and children;
to  establish,  maintain  and  manage  religious  and
educational institutions, orphanages, laboratories,
hospitals,  dispensaries  and  other  charitable
institutions for the Hindu community;
to train the teachers who are in the Hindu religious
institutions  and  carry  on  educational  activities
among the masses in all the branches of knowledge;
to  publish  through  print  or  electronic  media  and
distribute  books,  journals,  periodicals  and
magazines  which  the  Corporation  may  consider
desirable for the promotion and advancement of its
objects;
to  conduct  and  sponsor  conferences,  lectures,
seminars, workshops and group studies within or
outside Sri Lanka for Hindu religious personnel for
the  purpose  of  achieving  the  objects  of  the
Corporation;  and
to  collaborate  for  the  betterment  of  the  Hindu

Community  with  any  other 
institutions  or
organizations,  whether  foreign  or  local,  having
objects similar to those of the Corporation.
